title: Q3 Private Deploy Upgrade Confidence Program & Dark-Launch Plan
creator: Maya Chen
description: Organize a cross-functional program to increase customer upgrade success rate for Private/VPC/on-prem deployments. The goal is to reduce failed upgrade rollbacks by 60% and shrink average upgrade time and manual intervention for enterprise customers by end of Q3. This is a program-level initiative that bundles small runtime, orchestration, console, and docs changes into a single upgrade confidence funnel: automated preflight checks, staged dark-launch rollout capability, improved upgrade telemetry and rollback diagnostics, and an Operator-run checklist for customer success engineers. This ticket captures the roadmap and runbook authoring, plus stakeholder alignment and initial gating criteria.
acceptance_criteria: Automated preflight check suite runs in < 90s and flags >= 95% of known incompatibility classes
Dark-launch rollout in Console that can target 1%/5%/25%/100% cohorts and automatically revert on SLO breach
Upgrade telemetry dashboard with per-upgrade trace and top-3 root-cause classification visible to CS/SE
Customer-facing Operator checklist published with < 10 manual steps and linked runbooks
Run three internal pilot upgrades with non-production customers with success rate >= 95% and documented learnings
plan: Phase 0 (Jan) - Alignment: collect upgrade failure taxonomy from CS, SRE, and Eng; prioritize top 6 failure modes
Phase 1 (Feb) - Core infra: implement preflight checks and basic telemetry hooks in runtime; add dark-launch flag plumbing to Console
Phase 2 (Mar) - Orchestration & UX: cohort rollout UI, rollback triggers, and operator checklist integration
Phase 3 (Mar end) - Pilot & iterate: run 3 pilot upgrades with selected customers and internal testbeds; capture metrics and refine runbook
Phase 4 (Post-Q3) - Scale: expand dark-launch to Dedicated and Hosted parity, bake recommendations into onboarding flow
milestones: 2026-01-22: Failure taxonomy workshop completed (owners: CS - Lina Gomez, SRE - Omar Alvi)

risks: Hidden regression classes in older customer topologies - mitigation: add canary networks and synthetic workload tests
Telemetry volume increases cost - mitigation: sample and tier telemetry; prioritize traces for failing flows
Console UX rollout may be misused and trigger accidental rollouts - mitigation: require two-step confirmation and role gating
Dependency on Dedicated autoscaler changes (ENG-90211) - mitigation: coordinate weekly and add safe-fallback policy
notes: We will prioritize failure modes that account for >= 80% of historical upgrade incidents across top 20 customers.
Consider a temporary 'upgrade insurance' bucket for cost of additional e2e tests for pilot customers to accelerate adoption.
Trade-off: aggressive preflight checks increase false positives; we will tune thresholds and provide override path for customers with explicit waivers.
